messages:
Liam (Support): Escalation — Zephyr Labs onboarding blocked by quota/provisioning. Ticket #12345, tried re-provision twice, still getting 403 on model endpoint. Pilot kickoff scheduled Mon, renewal conversation due in 6 weeks. Marking P1 to CS.
Cory (CS Ops): Copy. Can you paste the error logs and confirm region and plan?
Liam (Support): Error snippet: `403 Forbidden: capacity not assigned to project zephyr-prod` — region us-west2, plan: dedicated-trial. They said billing already approved but we don't have the reservation.
Maya (CSM): Thanks — Zephyr Labs is a high-risk renewal if pilot slips. I can own customer comms and GTM plan, need engineering ETA.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): I can jump in. Quick check: did the reservation API return a 200 on our side? Liam, paste the provisioning call: `POST /v1/dedicated/reservations` payload?
Liam (Support): Paste below: ```json
{"project":"zephyr-prod","gpu_tier":"gpus-rtx","region":"us-west2","commit":"trial-30d"}
```
Liam (Support): Response: `202 Accepted` then `ERROR: allocation failed: insufficient capacity`
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Got it. Likely capacity shortage in us-west2 for that SKU. Options: 1) move them to us-east1 (short-term), 2) spin up a burst node on host pool M, 3) offer degraded trial with smaller concurrent limits.
Cory (CS Ops): For comms plan: we need owner, timeline, message template, and fallback. Maya (CSM) — you own comms; Jordan owns engineering remediation; Cory will coordinate billing/provisioning.
Maya (CSM): Agreed. I'll schedule an urgent 30m call with Zephyr for today or tomorrow. Proposed message: ```Hi @zephyr-ct o, quick update: we're seeing an allocation issue for your reserved capacity in us-west2; our engineering team is on it now. Options: a) migrate pilot to us-east1 (minimal change), b) short-term smaller-capacity run in us-west2. We recommend (a) to keep timeline. ETA for full fix ~48h. Would you like a vendor call now? — Maya (Redwood)```
Jordan (Solutions Eng): +1. I can be on the call. I estimate attempt to allocate burst node will take ~2-3h, but full re-provisioning across regions ~24-48h.
Liam (Support): Noted. I'll update ticket #12345 with the proposed options and flag for on-call provisioning.
Oncall Bot: Deploy bot: provisioning-burst request queued to pool-M, ID pb-9981. Estimated start in 18 minutes.
Cory (CS Ops): Internal comms timeline: 1) 15m — confirm customer availability for call; 2) 30m — internal triage + decision; 3) 1h — customer call; 4) 48h — resolution or migration. I'll create a dedicated channel for this escalation.
Maya (CSM): I'll send the message now, ask for availability for next 60m. Also looping in account exec for renewal touch: @alex-revenue.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): If migration chosen, checklist: update routing policy, regenerate endpoints, verify model variants. I'll post a short runbook after triage.
Liam (Support): Ticket updated with pb-9981 and triage notes. Adding logs and sample request IDs.
Maya (CSM): Quick note for the call agenda: 1) Acknowledge issue & impact, 2) Present options (migration vs degraded trial), 3) Confirm decision and timeline, 4) Schedule follow-up and success metrics. Keep tone: proactive, avoid technical blame.
Cory (CS Ops): I'll draft the internal comm: `#escalation-zephyr-1799998888` created. Invite: Maya, Jordan, Liam, Alex (sales), BillingOps.
Oncall Bot: Provisioning-burst pb-9981 started. Logs: https://internal.logs/prov/pb-9981
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Seeing the burst come up. Will attempt routing test in 10m and report.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Outcome goal: keep pilot kickoff on schedule Monday. If migration chosen, I need final decision within 2h so I can inform Zephyr and update the kickoff plan. :thumbsup:
Liam (Support): Will ping when routing test completes.
Cory (CS Ops): After call, we'll capture feedback in the onboarding playbook and add an entry for capacity checks during sales handoff to avoid repeat.
Maya (CSM): Closing loop: once resolved, I'll send a short survey about onboarding experience and capture any feature asks.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Routing test passed. Endpoint responding from burst node. Please confirm with Zephyr if they want migration or stay in us-west2 degraded.
Maya (CSM): On call with Zephyr now — they prefer migration to us-east1 to keep feature parity. They signed off on 1h downtime window.
Cory (CS Ops): Noted. Jordan, proceed with migration runbook. Liam, coordinate any customer-facing scripts.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Migration kickoff in 6m. I'll post progress updates in the channel.
Liam (Support): Will stand by for post-migration smoke tests.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone — this looks like averted churn risk. I'll follow up with renewal timeline update and add notes to the account health dashboard. :white_check_mark:
